methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: AI Ready Roanoke represents intentional community-led capacity building in a non-metro region, suggesting distributed peer learning networks could emerge outside traditional tech hubs if sustained with resources and coordination.

signals.title: News Flash Archive - NPD E911 Division implements Artificial Intelligence (AI) system on non-emergency lines - City of Norfolk (.gov)
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk's deployment of turnkey AI for E911 non-emergency lines demonstrates shallow, platform-driven adoption in government services—distributed geographically but not building deep local AI capability or expertise.

signals.title: AI is already common in Virginia Beach high schools. Leaders weigh guardrails - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: AI already commonplace in Virginia Beach schools signals rapid shallow distribution through commercial ed-tech platforms, with policy debate focused on guardrails rather than building student/teacher AI fluency—consumption over creation.

signals.title: UVA President Scott Beardsley charts University’s future in artificial intelligence - UVA Today
signals.signal_reading: UVA President's strategic AI initiative concentrates advanced research capability and talent development in flagship university, potentially deepening the expertise gap between university-adjacent regions and areas without R1 research infrastructure.

signals.title: ODU, CHKD want to map hotspots of childhood asthma in Hampton Roads with AI - WHRO
signals.signal_reading: ODU-CHKD partnership using AI for asthma mapping demonstrates deep technical application concentrated in research-hospital nexus, building specialized local capability but limited to institutional actors rather than distributed community capacity.
